player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''twigg''') posted a [[Dark]] [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB Operations]] list on DeckTech in October 2000.
description: This is Matt Sokol's World Champion's Dark Deck.  Built the night before day 3 by yours truly.	Original deck idea from Kim Caton, decades ago in Philly.  This deck is fast effective, and well, went 3-0 in Day 3 slaying Clint Hayes, Rafaiel A.,
cards: posted: ISB/Bad Mo'foe's who drain alot (st)
posted: Fozec {don't know how he got in there... -)
notes: Filed as general and credited to the builder, Brian Terwilliger: Matt Sokol played this ISB deck to win the 2000 World Championship; his list is already on the wiki as [[2000 Decipher World Championship Matt Sokol DS]] (SWCCGDB/Trandosite). The posted list differs in some slots (e.g. Tusken Canyon and Docking Bay 94, 9 Outer Rim Scouts, 'Hide and Seek', Unexpected Interruption here; 5D6-RA-7, Tempest Scout 5, Undercover x2, Den Of Thieves, There'll Be Hell To Pay and You Cannot Hide Forever there).

Total 60 as published. Section headers ('Locations (12)', 'Walkers and Ships (11)', 'Charachters (13)', 'Red (23)') are not cards. Cards marked '(st)' start: the Objective, Coruscant, 'Hide and Seek', 'Well Prepared', Imperial Arrest Order and Mobilization Points.

Posted 'Well Prepared (st)' dested Prepared Defenses (no card of that name exists; the starting Interrupt that brings in the three '(st)' Effects; Sokol's published list has Prepared Defenses). 'Hide and Seek (odds killer) (st)' is UNKNOWN (no card of that name); shown as posted and left out of GEMP.
The author's edit says Unexpected Interruption 'is suppose to be a Den of Theifs'; dested as posted (Unexpected Interruption).

Posted 'Docking Bay x2' dested the generic Spaceport Docking Bay (as in Sokol's list); 'Desert x2' the Special Edition generic Desert; 'Tat Deseret x2' Tatooine: Desert; 'Tat Docking Bay' Tatooine: Docking Bay 94; 'Caridia' Carida; 'Gkk' Ghhhk; 'Projected Telepathy' Projective Telepathy; 'Abyssn Ornament' Abyssin Ornament; 'Boba in Slave I' Boba Fett In Slave I. Secret Plans is the Special Edition Effect (not the later Defensive Shield).
player_note: Credited to the builder: the post's description says "This is Matt Sokol's World Champion's Dark Deck.  Built the night before day 3 by yours truly." and that it "went 3-0 in Day 3" (2000 Decipher World Championship, 7 October 2000). Sokol's list as published is [[2000 Decipher World Championship Matt Sokol DS]].
